title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 8: the forty years in the wilderness, manna, and the warning not to forget Yahweh in a good land.

questions.text: How long had Yahweh led Israel in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Moses tells them to remember the way Yahweh led them these forty years in the wilderness, to humble and test them.

questions.text: Complete Deuteronomy 8:3: "man does not live by bread only, but man lives by ..."
questions.explanation: Yahweh fed them with manna to teach them that man does not live by bread only, but by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh's mouth.

answers.text: the work of his own two hands
the water that comes from the rock of flint
the wisdom handed down by his fathers
every word that proceeds out of Yahweh's mouth

questions.text: What does Deuteronomy 8:4 say about their clothing and their feet during the forty years?
questions.explanation: Their clothing did not grow old on them, and their foot did not swell, these forty years.

answers.text: Their clothing didn't grow old and their feet didn't swell
Their clothing was replaced with new clothing every year
Their sandals were made new again on each Sabbath
Their feet were healed each morning by the manna

questions.text: Yahweh disciplines Israel in the same way as whom?
questions.explanation: They are to consider that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh their God disciplines them.

answers.text: A king who punishes a rebel
A judge who sentences a thief
A man who disciplines his son
A master who corrects a servant

questions.text: Which fruit is named in the description of the good land in Deuteronomy 8:8?
questions.explanation: It is a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey.

questions.text: What could they dig out of the hills of the land?
questions.explanation: It is a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills they may dig copper.

questions.text: Which creatures were in the great and terrible wilderness?
questions.explanation: Yahweh led them through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions and thirsty ground without water.

questions.text: Out of what did Yahweh pour water for them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh poured water for them out of the rock of flint.

questions.text: Who does Deuteronomy 8:18 say gives Israel the power to get wealth?
questions.explanation: They must not say their own power got them this wealth, but remember Yahweh their God, for it is he who gives them power to get wealth.

answers.text: The strength of their own hand

questions.text: What will happen if they forget Yahweh and serve other gods?
questions.explanation: Moses testifies that they would surely perish, just as the nations Yahweh makes to perish before them.

answers.text: They will lose only their flocks
They will wander another forty years
They will become servants of Moab
They will surely perish, like the nations
